description:
[Start here] Start here: which endpoint/tool answers which Rust question. The map for AI assistants and new API users: `tasks` (kinds of question -> the MCP tools that answer them,
each tool named after the endpoint it calls), `concepts` (the concept guides at `/learn/{topic}` - how Rust works,
from the core loop to server settings), `tool_groups` (every MCP tool by area), plus `glossary_terms` and the
conventions (cents, UTC, vanilla defaults). Read this once, then call the specific tool. START HERE when unsure which tool to use: maps every kind of Rust question to the tools that answer it, lists the concept guides and groups every tool.
name: rust_overview
